name: Santa Agata no Danzai
original_name: サンタ・アガタの断罪
source:
The peaceful world!
I won't give up on it!

So don't worry.
I'll create the peaceful world Morte wished for, in his place!
I'm confident in my swordsmanship, and even in my studies...
So...

Please, trust me.

[Translated from the [url=https://mamemaru092.wixsite.com/mamemaru09/複製-サンタ-キアラの楽園]official site[/url]]
